colorCorrection.algorithm: Per-row old last4 and new first4 native support. Robust2px medians with median local slope extrapolate to boundary. Reject support x-gradients>=10 or row-guide gradients>=9 or raw correction magnitude>=40. Guided33-row weighted median (97-row fallback only if sparse), then guided5-row smoothing of correction field only. RGB correction clamped32; smoothstep return to zero at x256. No spatial coordinate change.
